title: 4 Bedroom - Music Row!
description:
This Airbnb in Midtown Nashville is an absolute gem! Located just an 8-minute drive from the vibrant energy of Broadway and downtown Nashville, it strikes the perfect balance between accessibility and tranquility.

Ideal for larger parties, this spacious home ensures everyone's comfort with its generously sized rooms and bathrooms. One of its standout features is the convenience of walkable bars and restaurants like Barcelona Wine Bar and Old Glory. Lot's of parking is a PLUS!
